name: DaBai DCW2
summary: DaBai DCW2 is an Orbbec active-stereo structured-light depth camera for service-robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. It provides onboard depth processing and USB connectivity for embedded perception. The manufacturer publishes exact-model operating-range and field-of-view specifications; these are retained separately from related DaBai variants.
